property_summary: For any inputs, calling transfer(...) with an empty _tos array reverts in the correct contract (i.e. it never returns true), whereas the mutant that changes the require to `_tos.length >= 0` will return true for some inputs (it accepts empty arrays) — so the property is that transfer(...) must never return successfully (ok==true) when _tos is empty.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow zero-length _tos by using >= 0, causing behavior and return value differences when called with an empty array.
